Docket 1.3.126

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *Typefaces are counted as a reader sees them.* The brand check counted a theme's icon font (used only to
  draw the menu button) and the system fonts a site uses for code blocks as typefaces, which pushed one
  site's count from 8 to 11. Icon fonts are now recognised by what they draw, and the system code fonts are
  left out like other system fonts, so the count is of fonts that set text and that a visitor downloads.
- *Docket for Windows updates itself.* Before this release, an installed 1.3.125 on a clean Windows machine
  was offered a newer test build, downloaded it, checked its signature, installed it and reopened as the new
  version. The update log now also records how much it downloaded (it said 0 bytes).

99 checks across 13 areas.
